cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded EazyDiner Platinum card offering dining discounts, accelerated points at partner restaurants, and milestone dining vouchers.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: Using the EazyDiner Platinum Credit Card with PayEazy for payment provides an additional 20% discount up to ₹500.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Applicable exclusively via the app and not for direct restaurant payments. Discounts are automatically applied within the app, eliminating the need for promo codes.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your EazyDiner membership, check your email for the activation link and membership details. Visit the EazyDiner website or open the app, then register or log in using the details provided. Enter any promo or membership code you received to activate your benefits. Once activated, enjoy exclusive dining offers and priority reservations.
